stem: Reyansh traces partly digested food as it enters the small intestine. Basic pancreatic juice arrives there, major food components are digested, and digested nutrients move into the blood.

statements.text: Basic pancreatic juice in the small intestine can help neutralise acidic food from the stomach.
During absorption, digested nutrients move from blood vessels into the small intestine lining.
The small intestine digests major food components and absorbs digested nutrients into the blood.

teacher.key_rationale: Pancreatic juice is basic and can neutralise acidic food; digestion and absorption into blood occur in the small intestine. Absorption is into blood, not from blood into the lining.
